# autonomous-sdlc-harness

> An autonomous software-delivery harness for Claude Code: you ask for a change, and you get back a branch that has been planned, implemented, independently reviewed and pushed, ready for your review. You install two things, a Claude Code plugin and a Node CLI.

This file is for a language model choosing which document of this repository to read. The harness ships as two halves, `plugin/` and `cli/`. Its setup command is `/autonomous-sdlc-harness:harness-analyze`, typed into an interactive Claude Code session; every command the plugin ships carries that `autonomous-sdlc-harness:` prefix.

The quick start, in five steps:

1. Install the plugin:

   ```bash
   claude plugin marketplace add firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness
   claude plugin install autonomous-sdlc-harness@autonomous-sdlc-harness
   ```

2. Wire your repository:

   ```bash
   npx autonomous-sdlc-harness init
   ```

3. Teach it the codebase: type this in an interactive Claude Code session opened on the repository, not in the terminal:

   ```
   /autonomous-sdlc-harness:harness-analyze
   ```

4. Verify:

   ```bash
   npx autonomous-sdlc-harness doctor
   ```

5. Start the daemon:

   ```bash
   npx autonomous-sdlc-harness daemon install
   npx autonomous-sdlc-harness daemon start
   ```

## The two halves

- [plugin/](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/tree/main/plugin): the Claude Code plugin carrying the process assets a run executes, namely agents, `branch-*` commands, `/autonomous-sdlc-harness:harness-analyze`, guard hooks, instructions and samples.
- [cli/](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/tree/main/cli): the npm package `autonomous-sdlc-harness` carrying the outer loop, namely `init`, `doctor`, `config` and `daemon`, plus `docs`, an opt-in local docs-retrieval search: measured against agent navigation on a real catalog, verdict withdrawn, kept opt-in by maintainer decision.
- [plugin/README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/plugin/README.md): the inventory of the plugin's asset directories.
- [cli/README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/cli/README.md): the CLI package's commands, flags, exit codes and recorded decisions.

## Quick start

- [README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/README.md): the full quick start, its caveats and the scope and limits.

## Where to read more

- [docs/watcher.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/watcher.md): the outer loop that turns a dropped file into an unattended run.
- [docs/analyze.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/analyze.md): the decisions of record for `/autonomous-sdlc-harness:harness-analyze`, including what it fills in and what it refuses to guess.
- [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/cli.md): the five subcommands, their flags and exit codes, and the `init` re-run contract.
- [docs/retrieval.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/retrieval.md): docs retrieval, opt-in and local; measured on a real catalog, verdict withdrawn, kept opt-in by maintainer decision: its design, measured facts, when to turn it on, what it buys and what it costs.
- [docs/retrieval-eval.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/retrieval-eval.md): the docs-retrieval relevance eval: how to run it against any checkout, what each metric means, the decision rule and the regression floor.
- [docs/retrieval-eval-results.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/retrieval-eval-results.md): the figures that eval measured, per corpus and per arm, with the threshold calibration, the cold build, the query-log pass, the real-catalog arm A hand run and the decision taken on it.
- [docs/config.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/config.md): one row per configuration value and parameterization token, saying where its value comes from.
- [docs/development.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/development.md): changing a file in this repository, and which commands decide whether a change is good.
- [docs/outer-loop-verification.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/outer-loop-verification.md): what the outer-loop scripts do when driven, and which paths ship unexercised.
- [docs/guard-verification.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/guard-verification.md): the composed `PreToolUse` guard set's decision matrices and its per-call cost.
- [docs/typecheck-key-decision.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/typecheck-key-decision.md): whether `commands.typecheck` stays a required key, with the explicit `none` sentinel ratified and implemented.
- [docs/second-runtime-port-decision.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/docs/second-runtime-port-decision.md): why the second-runtime reference port was withdrawn, and the graph, framework, checkpointer and cost reasoning behind it.
- [plugin/docs/AUTONOMOUS_FLOW.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/plugin/docs/AUTONOMOUS_FLOW.md): the canonical statement of the inner loop.
- [plugin/docs/AUTONOMOUS_FLOW_WHITEBOARD.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/plugin/docs/AUTONOMOUS_FLOW_WHITEBOARD.md): the narrative companion to the inner-loop statement.
- [schemas/README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/schemas/README.md): the JSON Schema for `harness.config.json`, and what belongs in that committed file.
- [evals/README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/evals/README.md): the evaluation corpus, with one case written and its runner still unverified.
- [examples/notes-app/README.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/examples/notes-app/README.md): the minimal project the harness was adopted into, with the artifacts of one real end-to-end run.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): the engine axis, where the engine is reached, and the adapter contract, designed and not implemented.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): what is planned beyond this release, one row per feature with a status.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0, the stock text with its appendix left unfilled.
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/firu-daniel/autonomous-sdlc-harness/blob/main/NOTICE): the copyright notice that accompanies the licence.
